issues.description: The exercise asks students to "Implement getters for each attribute of the Lecture class" (public getters are expected by the task and referenced test names), but the solution implementation makes some getters private (e.g. getLectureName() and getNumberOfInscribedStudents()). This visibility difference conflicts with the problem specification and will confuse students and/or cause tests expecting public access to fail.
issues.suggestedFix: Ensure getters for all attributes are declared public to match the problem statement and tests. In the solution (and template examples if present), change getLectureName() and getNumberOfInscribedStudents() to public (or make all attribute getters public consistently). This aligns the implementation with the exercise instructions and expected tests.
